text:
sam: Heads up — getting a steady 5xx spike on api-redwood-1 across a bunch of routes, customers reporting timeouts. paging @oncall.
incident-bot: Pager delivered to @maria (oncall). Severity: P1. Link: https://redwood.incidents/2102467890
maria: ACK. Joining bridge now. any obvious deploys?
blake: no deploys in last 30m. seeing increase in backend errors from model-routing service (route-mgr). logs show transient KV sharding errors. snippet:```
2026-03-15T12:33:21Z ERROR route-mgr shard=7 op=lookup err="timeout to kvstore"
2026-03-15T12:33:24Z WARN router request_id=abc123 latency=1200ms
```
tina: I'm on support side — fielding incoming tickets, marking customer-impact. Customers A and C reported timeouts and degraded answers. ETA to notify CSMs?
support-bot: Notified CSMs for affected accounts: acct-A, acct-C. Channel: #customer-ops.
maria: OK live plan: 1) Reroute 20% of traffic off route-mgr to fallback routing (stateless) 2) Roll traffic to smaller quantized model variant for affected endpoints 3) Open a follow-up for root cause. Doing step 1 now.
blake: triggering routing rule rollback:```
kubectl -n infra exec router-ctrl -- curl -X POST http://localhost/route/rebalance -d '{"percent":20,"target":"fallback"}'
```
blake: rule applied, canary shows error rate dropping for the canary shard.
maria: Rolling fallback model (small-quant-v2) for 15% of requests on the effected endpoints to reduce backend pressure.
adeeb: adding notes — we should be careful about quality regressions but this is customer-impacting so agree. Creating action items now.
tina: Support doc for customers updated: "We're routing you to a fallback until we stabilize routing; you may see shorter responses." please ping when we have postmortem link.
blake: monitoring: p95 latency back to baseline in canary, overall 5xx rate trending down. throttles look lower.
maria: good. I'm preparing a short bridge summary for execs. For oncall handoff in 30m, will warm-handoff to adeeb who is next.
incident-bot: Bridge created: https://redwood.bridge/2102467890. Attaching timeline.
adeeb: I can take second shift. will pick up 30m. items to follow: logging changes for KV timeouts, increase read timeout, and route-mgr retry logic.
sam: thanks. once stable we should schedule a postmortem and prioritize alert tuning. current alert was too noisy and fired before mitigations were actionable.
tina: +1. Support wants clearer customer-impact fields in alerts (affected accounts list).
adeeb: ACTION-1: Create postmortem doc + timeline (assignee: adeeb) — jira: RW-INC-5271.
adeeb: ACTION-2: Alert tuning — dedupe duplicate 5xx alerts across router & route-mgr, and add a rolling-p95 > 800ms SLO alert (assignee: blake) — jira: RW-OPS-3322.
blake: ACTION-3: Add KV client exponential backoff + instrumentation (assignee: blake) — jira: RW-RTE-1109.
maria: ACTION-4: Hand-off note & customer outreach summary (assignee: maria). I will create the postmortem skeleton and invite stakeholders.
tina: ACTION-5: Support followups — send standardized customer note + CSM updates (assignee: tina).
sam: Can we also add an immediate short-term alert suppression rule to reduce duplicate paging for this class? maybe a 5min dedupe window per request_id.
adeeb: yes. I'll prototype a dedupe rule in the alert router and post YAML here.
blake: putting quick snippet for dedupe rule:```yaml
- alert: RouteMgrHigh5xx
  for: 2m
  dedupe: request_id_window: 5m
  expr: sum(rate(route_mgr_5xx[1m])) > 10
```
blake: noting quality regression risk for model fallback; we should include evaluation snapshots in the postmortem.
adeeb: scheduling: postmortem writeup meeting Friday 2026-03-20 15:00 UTC. I'll post the calendar invite. (incident-bot: postmortem created: https://redwood.pm/postmortems/5271)
incident-bot: Postmortem doc created and assigned to adeeb. Reminder set for 2026-03-19 to draft initial timeline.
maria: current status: mitigation in place, 5xxs near baseline, support outreach active. prepping handoff to adeeb in 20m.
sam: great work. after handoff please ensure alerts are muted for the noisy signal while postmortem actions are tracked.
tina: support will keep a triage log. will add customer messages to the postmortem doc.
adeeb: will take over. following up after handoff with a consolidated action tracker.
blake: quick note for SRE team — add a follow-up on test harness to simulate KV timeouts in staging.
maria: handing off to adeeb now. adeeb, you're live. :white_check_mark:
adeeb: ACK. taking over. will post the action tracker link in the postmortem and assign owners.
incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging. Follow-ups tracked in RW-INC-5271 and RW-OPS-3322.
sam: closing notes: review SLO burn window and consider adjusting paging thresholds; we can keep this thread for updates but move action items into RW-INC-5271. :thumbsup:
